pages.title: Sonic Boom
pages.text: Start position (Vec3), direction (Vec3), power (double) -> Sonic Boom ->

Pops three parameters from the spell stack in order: first parameter as start position, second as launch direction (its magnitude is attack distance), third as attack power.
Launches a sonic wave from start position along direction, dealing damage and knockback to creatures in path.

Damage = 45 × power
Mana cost = 5 × (23 + power)^(1 + power/10)

This rune has strict parameter reading order due to duplicate parameter types.
Stack is LIFO, so input order should be: power (double), direction (vec3), start position (vec3)
